title: De Profundis
author: Oscar Wilde
description: "De Profundis" by Oscar Wilde is a letter written between January and March 1897 during his imprisonment in Reading Gaol.
longDescription: Explore Grief, Imprisonment, Suffering, Wilde, Oscar, 1854-1900. This complete source edition preserves the original text and its period language, with the edition credits and licence included.
rights: Source edition: public domain in the United States. Listed creative contributors screened for India, UK and EU; original licence retained.

authorInfo.bio: Oscar Wilde was an Irish writer celebrated for his wit, fairy tales and plays. The Picture of Dorian Gray is his only novel. His other works include The Importance of Being Earnest, The Happy Prince and The Ballad of Reading Gaol, spanning comedy, beauty and painful reflection.
authorInfo.edition: Complete source edition with preface and twenty chapters. Cover reproduced from the Project Gutenberg source EPUB.

editionCredits: Transcribed from the 1913 Methuen & Co. edition by David Price. Note that later editions of De Profundis contained more material. The most complete editions are still in copyright in the U.S.A

rightsReview.policy: Source states US public domain; listed creative contributors died by 1945. Unknown dates excluded. This is a screening record, not a legal certification.
